description: Aménagements cyclables du Finistère is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Conseil départemental du Finistère. This geographical layer makes it possible to locate all the cycling facilities on the departmental roads of Finistère (29). The structure of these data corresponds to the national scheme of cycling facilities ( facilities/standards-and-standards-national-schema-of-cycling facilities). Coverage: Conseil départemental du Finistère. The portal shows the English title as "Cycling facilities in Finistère" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Conseil départemental du Finistère. Its keywords include cyclable, finistere, amenagements, piste-cyclable, bretagne, schema-cyclable. The listing shows 3 download or service links in CSV, GEOJSON, ZIP. The listing shows 2024-09-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
